header.about: Quicksilver's rest and meditate regeneration, one engine run per column. kind standing: the mana a 30-second tick gives a standing player (unchanged by the 1.20 rules; the column is the same in both). kind hp: the hit points one rest tick gives, which meditating gives too; base is the value before it is tripled. kind tick: the mana of 30 consecutive rest (21 s) or meditate (15 s) ticks for a standing rate, with the remainder carried. kind recovery: 5-second rounds to go from no mana to a target (999 when not reached), resting or meditating, standing ticks included; inputs.standing is the standing rate of the caster. v120 is the 1.20.0 balance; neutral has both multiples at 1, so resting and meditating add nothing to the standing rate.
